IT IS UNKNOWN IF THE HOUSE IS LOCATED ON THE GLENDALE END OF NORTH IROQUOIS AVE OR THE WHITEFISH BAY END.

Location2: SUNNY SIDE ISLAND ON THE ST LAWRENCE RIVER

Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: P/V ISLAND DUCHESS
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 43.299428, -74.217933 (Approximated from administrative_area_level_1)
Report DescriptionINFORMATION RECEIVED FROM SECTOR BUFFALO AND THE NATIONAL COMMAND CENTER: * USCG SECTOR BUFFALO INITIATED A CRITICAL INCIDENT COMMUNICATION (CIC) CONFERENCE CALL CONCERNING THE PASSENGER FERRY VESSEL ISLAND DUCHESS WHICH RAN AGROUND ON THE SAINT LAWRENCE RIVER NEAR SUNNY SIDE ISLAND, NY. THE VESSEL HAD 134 PASSENGERS ONBOARD DURING THE TIME OF INCIDENT WITH 00 INJURIES REPORTED. A FUEL TANK WAS BREACHED DUE TO THE GROUNDING; THE BREACH RESULTED IN THE VESSEL TAKING ON WATER. DURING THE CIC CALL, THE VESSEL WAS ABLE TO STOP THE WATER INTAKE. THERE IS SHEENING IN THE WATERWAY DUE TO A DISCHARGE OF HYDRAULIC LEAK. *USCG SECTOR BUFFALO ISSUED AN URGENT MARINE INFORMATION BROADCAST (UMIB), LAUNCHED USCG STATION ALEXANDRIA BAY AND JOINT RESCUE COORDINATION CENTER SURFACE AND AIR ASSETS. THE VESSEL'S OWNERS HAVE LAUNCHED ANOTHER ASSET (P/V UNCLE SAM 7) TO TRANSPORT THE PASSENGERS SHORE SIDE. ETA FOR P/V UNCLE SAM 7 IS CURRENTLY UNKNOWN. THERE IS NO WATERWAY IMPACT AT THIS TIME. THERE IS CURRENTLY NO MEDIA ATTENTION. SECTOR BUFFALO STATED THERE MAY BE A POTENTIAL RELEASE OF 1500 GALLONS OF AN UNKNOWN OIL FROM THE VESSEL.

properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 1074496 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: NATIONAL BEARINGS COMPANY
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1074496
Incident Time: 2014-02-17 12:02:00
Nearest City: Lancaster, PA
Location: CORNER OF FLORY MILL RD AND MANHEIM PIKE, LANCASTER,PA. 1596 MANHEIM PIKE
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: UNKNOWN OIL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: NATIONAL BEARINGS COMPANY
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.108406, -76.352585 (Approximated from ZIP)
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** COMPANY HAS FLUME SYSTEM FOR REMOVING METAL CHIPS FROM PROCESSING ON MULTISPINDLE SCREW MACHINES. THE FLUME SYSTEM WAS NOT CONTAINING THE CUTTING OIL AND IT SOAKED INTO THE GROUND AND WATER SUPPLY. THERE ARE THOUSANDS OF GALLONS OF OIL UNDER THE BUILDING AND SURROUNDING AREA. THEY DUMPED CAUSTICS DOWN THE DRAIN IN THE SOUTHWEST CORNER OF THE BUILDING THEN COVERED IT WITH CONCRETE. THIS DRAINED DIRECTLY INTO THE GROUND NOT A SEWER. ANOTHER DEPARTMENT DUMPED THEIR OVERFLOW WASTE FULL OF HEAVY METALS INTO THE SEWER SYSTEM. IN THE SPRING THE WATER TABLES RISE AND PUSH UP THE OIL WHICH KILLS THE GRASS ON THE FAR SIDE OF THE PARKING LOT. OIL SEEPS THROUGH THE WALL OF THE TANK ROOM AND SATURATES THE EAST SIDE OF THE BUILDING. SOIL SAMPLES WILL REVEAL OIL AND CAUSTICS DUMPED UNDER THE GRASS AND OUT BEYOND THE DRIVEWAY.
